activities.name: Financial Literacy Outreach to Migrant Workers' Children

rationale.intuition: Penn ED 14.22% overall; intl admit 2.79% (RD). Public-CN HS gaokao path is a rare profile at Wharton — gaokao 720/750 ≈ top 0.05% nationally normalizes to ~3.9-4.0 unweighted. Major concerns: (1) Wharton is the most competitive Penn school for intl, (2) lack of US-style activities/leadership common in 国际部 applicants, (3) ED boost still applies but capped by Wharton's intl quota. Industry: Public-CN gaokao applicants at Wharton ED are rare (~30-50/year), 3-10% admit per Crimson case data.

sources.name: UPenn CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit 5.38%; ED 14.22%; intl admit 2.79%. Wharton sub-school admit ~50-60% of overall Penn rate.

sources.name: Crimson Education Wharton Intl Benchmark 2024
sources.evidence: Chinese gaokao-path applicants (vs 国际部) at Wharton ED cluster 3-8% in published case data; gaokao 700+ treated as exceptional academic signal but limited activity differentiation.

sources.name: Common App Gaokao Pathway Report 2024
sources.evidence: Common App accepts gaokao scores as supplementary academic record; AO conversion: 700/750 → ~3.9-4.0 unweighted equivalent (top decile).
